Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was operating a sedan southbound and attempting a left turn at an intersection in League City, Texas, when
the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by a pickup truck traveling northbound, operated by Driver 2. Driver 1
repotred pain in the right knee after the collision and was transported for evaluation. The injury reported is consistent
with the type and force of this impact, given how the sedan's left side was driven into and the way the occupant
compartment was affected. Damage visible on the sedan matches the described sequence of events, and no prior
damage to the vehicle was known to either party or noted at the scene. Responding officers confirmed that Driver 1
was insdie the vehicle at the time of the crash, and the Passenger seated in the front right position was also present
and was checked at the scene. Scene photographs confirm several details reported by both drivers, including final
rest positions and debris location. No independent witnesses were located at the scene or identified afterward. Driver
1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the sedan, which was verified during the investigation.
